validity.recommendation: Check Length: the one readable source gives 1254 km for the first line against 1262 km on the sheet. Re-source away from energybase.ru, which is blocked from here.
validity.researcher_notes: The line is real. Interfax (June 2019) reports Gazprom liquidating it, and a Komsomolskaya Pravda company timeline lists the first line (1956, 1254 km, 720 mm). It is a Russian domestic trunk to Moscow, not in Ukraine, so it sits outside the Ukraine system even though the sheet lists it here. It is correctly classified as a gas transmission line. No other row on the roster is the same pipe. The Ukraine gas transmission article cited by the sheet's page does not name this line. The sheet's main cited page, energybase.ru, returns an access-blocked page; the old url_verifier pass on it was a false match.
